question: There are three persons M,N And P. They are running in the same direction around a circular track of length 150 m. Their speeds are 20 m/sec,15 m/sec and 12 m/sec, respectively. If they start at same time and same point, then after what time do they meet for the first time?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When running in the same direction, the first meeting time anywhere is the LCM of their pair-wise relative meeting times.

Time for M and N to meet = Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 150 ÷ (20 − 15) = 30 sec.

Time for N and P to meet = Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 150 ÷ (15 − 12) = 50 sec.

Time to meet for all three = LCM(30, 50) = 150 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 150 sec.**
